links.outcome: F1 for extracting colonoscopy recall recommendations: LLM versus rule-based NLP on same held-out notes
links.effect: GPT-4 Turbo F1 0.89 (CI 0.65-0.92) versus rule-based spaCy NLP F1 0.78 (CI 0.58-0.82), N=326 notes; confidence intervals overlap
links.quote: Expanded validation on a held-out set demonstrated improved F1 (0.89; CI = [0.65, 0.92], N = 326) relative to a traditional rule-based NLP approach (F1 = 0.78; CI = [0.58, 0.82]).

unlisted_practices: Layered pre-upload quality control for LLM-extracted data migration (manual review, field validation, anomaly detection)
Prompt optimization against clinician consensus before scaled LLM extraction

screen.reason: Evaluates the design, implementation, and deployment of an end-to-end LLM-driven workflow to extract colonoscopy recall recommendations during an EHR migration for over 118,000 patients.
